incident_text: Site 03 backhaul link shows link down, radio hardware still alarming healthy.
Cell at site 07 has latency over 200ms for the last hour, throughput looks normal.
Site 12 packet loss climbed to 4% over the last 15 minutes.
Subscribers at site 05 report no internet access, backhaul and radio both look healthy.
Site 09 throughput dropped to 40% of baseline only between 6pm and 9pm.
Site 14 has gone completely unreachable, including on the management plane.
Handover success rate between site 02 and site 03 dropped sharply this morning.
VoLTE call drop rate at site 08 is elevated, drops concentrated near the cell edge.
Site 16 PRB utilization has been above 92% for six straight hours.
Site 11 baseband unit has rebooted five times in the last twenty minutes.
Site 04 dropped briefly with a mains-power-loss alarm then battery engaged, now back on mains.
Site 19 microwave backhaul RSL has been degraded since the storm started an hour ago.
Site 06 RRC connection setup failure rate spiked right after last night's firmware push.
A site-to-site VPN tunnel between site 10 and the core has been down for 30 minutes.
Site 17 IPsec tunnel to the core failed to renegotiate this morning, no config changes reported.
